<?php

{
    public function __construct(
        private string $id,
        #[Foo(value: 1234, otherValue: [1, 2, 3])]
        #[Bar(Bar::BAZ, array('[',']'))]
        private ?string $name = null,
    ) {}
}

    ) {}
}

]

) {}

    Foo\Bar,
    Foo\Baz,
